config.logLevel: Log level for the extension and the Python backends it starts (propagated through BINHOST_LOG_LEVEL).
config.keymap.default: Keep the standard Pile ou Face keyboard shortcuts.
config.keymap.ida: Enable N (rename), X (xrefs), ; (comment) and G (go to) in disassembly and decompilation views.
config.keymap: Keyboard shortcut layout in static analysis views.
config.perfDiagnostics: Enable webview/extension host performance snapshots in Pile ou Face logs. Disabled by default in published builds.
config.autoTriage.enabled: Automatically start AI auto-triage (LLM-based function naming/comments) after successful disassembly. Disabled by default: binary code is sent to the AI provider only after explicit consent, manual disassembly through ‘Pile ou Face: AI Auto-triage’, or enabling this setting.
config.autoTriage.model: AI model dedicated to auto-triage, separate from the Assistant model. Use an Ollama model name (for example ‘qwen2.5-coder:7b’) or ‘provider@model’ for a cloud provider. Leave empty to reuse the chat model.
config.autoTriage.maxFunctions: Maximum number of functions analyzed by auto-triage.
config.autoTriage.maxSeconds: Maximum auto-triage duration in seconds, checked between functions.
config.autoTriage.maxTokensPerRequest: Maximum number of tokens generated per AI response during auto-triage.
config.autoTriage.maxTotalTokens: Maximum total token budget for auto-triage, including the summary.
config.telemetry.enabled: Allow aggregated Pile ou Face usage metrics when VS Code telemetry is also enabled. No analyzed content is sent.
config.runtimeUsageAudit: Enable runtime auditing of commands, webview messages and Python subprocesses in storageDir/audit-runtime-usage.jsonl. Disabled by default.
